label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: The code resolves the hostname to an IP and checks if it starts with "10." or "192.168.", but fails to block loopback addresses (127.x.x.x) or other reserved ranges. An attacker can supply "127.0.0.1" as the parameter value, bypassing the check and allowing the server to connect to localhost. Resolved sink value: http://127.0.0.1 (derived from user input).

evidence.note: User input flows to host variable, IP check misses 127.0.0.1, leading to connection on line 24.
